newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Tsum retailer ADR programme live - consultant.
newsitem.headline: Russia Tsum retailer ADR programme live - consultant.

text.p: Russian retailer TsUM has launched its Level One American Depositary Receipt programme, financial consultant OLMA said on Tuesday.
It said ADRs, each covering 20 locally-traded shares of OAO Torgovy Dom TsUM held by depositary Bank of New York, had begun trading on foreign markets on July 3.
Russian companies use ADRs to increase their shares' liquidity and price through exposure to a wider range of foreign investors than is available on the domestic market.
Local shares of Moscow-based Tsum were unchanged at $0.86 on on Tuesday morning from Monday's close on the Russian Trading System.
